limitations: Single-view guidance produces an authored procedural interpretation. Hidden anatomy and the overall 3.0 m scale are inferred. Fine wrinkles, facial detail and ear-fold complexity remain simpler than the reference.

V4 is darker and browner than Blender, with a heavier projected ground shadow and a faint dotted shadow-proxy edge behind the trunk. Finished episode lighting and renderer appearance parity are not accepted.
LTC supplies rectangular area-light shading. Floor shadows use a separate zero-illumination directional VSM proxy; this does not establish LTC occlusion, full self-shadowing or global illumination.
V4 verification covers an isolated static composition and repeated stills. It does not cover original episode migration, video, continuous playback, same-page seek or every-frame validation.
No rig, animation, cloth or physics is implemented. Trellis2 was not used or modified. No external generation service, pretrained model, downloaded elephant or texture pipeline was used.
Human acceptance remains NOT_REVIEWED and production_ready remains false. Independent reviewer identity is supplied by the trusted local client, not cryptographically authenticated.
